facts.claim: Diamba Sud initial capital costs increased 40% to $398 million compared to the preliminary economic assessment.

facts.subject: Diamba Sud
facts.cause: feasibility study updates to resource model

facts.claim: Diamba Sud has estimated probable reserves of 20.5 million tonnes at 1.75 grams gold per tonne for 1.1 million ounces of gold.
facts.subject: Diamba Sud
facts.cause: feasibility study results

facts.claim: Diamba Sud internal rate of return decreased 12 percentage points to 60% due to higher capital and sustaining costs in the feasibility study.
